output.objection: No, we are not automating the registry gate. Every model must pass a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics before it can be promoted to production.
output.correction: I am not talking about the nightly forecast job or the store manager app. I am talking about the model registry, which is where we enforce privacy and quality controls before anything touches the live data.
